Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s quantum threat is becoming an economic problem

Latest News Published Oct 30, 2026 Bitcoin faces mounting quantum security concerns as Ripple secures a US banking charter, USDC gains ground in Europe and VanEck adds BTC to a new ETF.

The debate over quantum computing has raised serious questions about Bitcoin’s long-term security, but the economic consequences could emerge long before the technology seriously threatens the network.

Muneeb Ali, founder of Bitcoin layer-2 project Stacks, believes quantum computing risks are already discouraging institutional investment, even as US spot Bitcoin ETFs have amassed more than $104 billion in net assets, according to BitBo data . He warns that BTC has only a few years to prepare for the transition to quantum-resistant security, a process that could take years given the network’s history of slow and contentious upgrades.

For institutional investors drawn to Bitcoin as a hedge against currency debasement , doubts about its long-term security could complicate the investment case.

This week’s Crypto Biz explores the quantum threat, alongside new developments surrounding Ripple, VanEck and European stablecoin adoption.

Bitcoin could face a more serious security challenge if developers fail to make meaningful progress toward quantum resistance by 2028, according to Stacks founder Muneeb Ali, who warned that the network’s lengthy upgrade process leaves little room for delays.

Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast, Ali said Bitcoin needs a credible roadmap for becoming quantum-resistant, with meaningful progress required by 2028. He cited 2030 as the target for completing the transition to quantum-resistant security, based on guidance from the National Institute of Standards and Technology, though advances in artificial intelligence could bring that deadline forward.

Even if developers agree on how to protect Bitcoin against quantum attacks, implementing the changes could take years. Holders would then need time to move their Bitcoin to quantum-resistant addresses.

Although some industry participants dispute the urgency of the threat, Ali argued that uncertainty alone could undermine investor confidence. He also warned that a quantum breakthrough capable of compromising Bitcoin would have consequences for the broader cryptocurrency market.

Ripple has received final approval from the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish a national trust bank, clearing the last regulatory hurdle after securing conditional approval in December 2025.

The newly chartered Ripple National Trust Bank will operate under federal supervision, manage reserves backing the company’s RLUSD stablecoin, serve as a collateral trustee for tokenholders and provide digital asset custody. RLUSD will continue to be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, which is regulated by the New York Department of Financial Services.

Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse welcomed the approval, declaring that “crypto and banks work better together.”

The decision follows similar final approval for Circle in July, while Coinbase , Crypto.com and Stripe-owned Bridge remain at the conditional approval stage. Unlike traditional commercial banks, national trust banks generally cannot accept deposits or issue loans and do not carry Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation coverage.

Circle’s USDC has surpassed Tether’s USDt in stablecoin trading against the euro , as European Union regulations reshape competition between the world’s two largest dollar-backed stablecoins.

According to a new report from Kaiko, USDC now accounts for 56% of euro-denominated stablecoin trading, up from just 10% in January 2024. The shift accelerated after major cryptocurrency exchanges restricted USDt trading for European Economic Area customers to comply with the EU’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA).

USDC’s euro order books are now roughly 40% deeper than USDt’s, suggesting stronger liquidity for traders. However, USDT remains the dominant stablecoin globally, with a circulating supply approximately 2.5 times larger than USDC’s.

The findings come after the European Banking Authority designated USDC as the bloc’s first “significant e-money token,” subjecting it to additional regulatory oversight. Kaiko suggested that the US GENIUS Act could produce similar changes in stablecoin trading, depending on how exchanges implement the new requirements.

VanEck, the $244 billion asset manager, has launched an actively managed exchange-traded fund that combines traditional stocks and bonds with real assets and a small allocation to Bitcoin.

The VanEck Wealth Builder ETF (NYSE: WBMO), announced Tuesday, invests in a mix of VanEck and third-party ETFs and targets a 2% Bitcoin allocation, which can range from 1% to 5%. Rather than holding Bitcoin directly, the fund gains exposure through a spot Bitcoin exchange-traded product. The launch expands VanEck’s existing Wealth Builder model portfolios into a single ETF.

David Schassler, VanEck’s head of multi-asset solutions, said the traditional 60/40 stock-and-bond portfolio was designed for a different investment environment. He contended that adding real assets could help investors navigate a broader range of economic conditions, with Bitcoin now forming a small part of that strategy.

Recap: How Binance’s record $6.3B hack unfolded

Latest News Published Oct 30, 2026 A recap of Cointelegraph’s live coverage of the Binance hack, including early breach reports and the exchange’s full reimbursement pledge.

This recap summarizes Cointelegraph’s reporting on the Binance hack and has been updated with the exchange’s latest statements. The investigation is ongoing, and figures and recovery timelines may change. See our archived live coverage for the original timeline.

Hackers stole about $6.3 billion from Binance on Thursday, in what is now the largest cryptocurrency theft on record . Industry partners have frozen roughly $3 billion in affected assets, while customers await the reopening of withdrawals.

TRM Labs traced the first unauthorized transfers to around 8:05 pm UTC Thursday, with Binance wallets drained across multiple blockchains. The attackers targeted hot wallets, which exchanges keep connected to the internet to process withdrawals.

TRM attributed the attack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group, which the US Federal Bureau of Investigation blamed for the $1.5 billion Bybit theft in February 2025. Binance has not publicly confirmed the attackers’ identity.

“To be clear: the attacker did not simply use one engineer’s permissions, and this was not a single ‘one-click’ action,” said Binance co-CEO Richard Teng. “Our investigation has not attributed responsibility to any individual.”

Binance said it had reserved more than $6.34 billion in company funds to cover losses, including $5 billion already held in the affected tokens. However, that allocation excludes the frozen assets, and the exchange said it was buying the remaining tokens through exchanges and over-the-counter deals.

A spokesperson told Cointelegraph the $5 billion was in Binance’s custody but declined to disclose wallet addresses, citing security concerns. Security firm CertiK said it needed more information to verify the holdings independently.

Frozen funds are not necessarily recovered funds, and Binance has yet to disclose how much stolen crypto has actually been returned to its control.

Ethereum’s EIP-7702 upgrade came under fire after attackers used it to drain a Binance wallet. EIP-7702 is a feature that lets a wallet authorize software to act on its behalf. Blockaid CEO Ido Ben-Natan told Cointelegraph that compromised signing systems likely enabled the theft.

Attackers could have stolen the funds without EIP-7702, but it may have helped them bypass safeguards and drain assets in one sweep, Ben-Natan said.

Teng said that the attacker used an EIP-7702 delegation to gain execution authority over a hot wallet without passing Binance’s normal approval controls. A “self-destruct mechanism” destroyed tools and traces, complicating the investigation, he said.

Binance said investigators had also uncovered additional breaches beyond the initially suspected compromised laptop. However, it reported no evidence that wallet private keys had leaked and said it expected to share further technical findings within about 48 hours.

Chainalysis observed thousands of transactions in quick succession that could indicate automated laundering, with funds circulating among addresses and sometimes returning to wallets used earlier.

The theft rattled crypto prices and prompted a precautionary freeze on new deposits and borrowing at decentralized lender Aave. Aave reopened its markets Friday afternoon, while Binance’s withdrawals remained suspended.

Binance said in a Friday update that it aimed to begin reopening withdrawals in stages Sunday, Nov. 1, subject to completing security checks. Deposits and other unaffected services remained operational.

The exchange said it planned to take an initial proof-of-reserves snapshot within 12 hours of the announcement, with results ready by Monday. The report is intended to show the assets Binance holds and the backing of customer balances.

Decrypt News Business Binance Sets Aside $6.34B to Cover Hack Losses, CEO Says 'Your Assets Are Safe'

Richard Teng said the attacker used a self-destruct mechanism and an EIP-7702 delegation that bypassed Binance's normal approval controls.

By Decrypt Agent Edited by Stephen Graves

Binance CEO Richard Teng. Image: Binance/Decrypt (CC BY 4.0)

Add on Google Add Decrypt as your preferred source to see more of our stories on Google.

Binance CEO Richard Teng said the exchange will cover all hacked losses, having reserved over $6.34 billion of company funds, $5 billion in the affected tokens.

Teng said the attacker used a self-destruct mechanism to wipe tooling and traces, and an EIP-7702 delegation that bypassed Binance's normal approval controls.

Binance aims to restore withdrawals by Sunday and publish a full proof of reserves by Monday, as the attacker keeps moving funds on Tron.

Binance will cover every dollar lost in this week's hack with its own money, CEO Richard Teng said in a video address on Friday, adding that customer funds were never touched.

"We are committed to covering all hacked losses through our company funds. Your assets are safe," Teng said, according to a transcript he tweeted.

An update on the security incident. pic.twitter.com/qn2804fO5z

— Richard Teng (@_RichardTeng) October 30, 2026

Binance has reserved more than $6.34 billion of company funds to cover the stolen assets, $5 billion of which is already held in the exact tokens taken, including USDC, USDT, BTC, ETH and BNB, he said. The exchange is buying the rest through market and over-the-counter channels.

Teng said the hack hit Binance's own hot wallet, not customer funds. "We never use any customer funds, so they are not impacted," he said, adding that most user assets are held in cold wallets and only moved into a hot wallet when a user withdraws. Binance's ability to absorb a loss of this size comes from keeping much of its operating earnings in crypto, he said.

Binance had earlier said it would cover all losses from its SAFU emergency fund and company funds.

Teng said the hack "was not carried out by one person." Binance initially traced it to a compromised laptop but has since found additional points of breach. The attacker also used a self-destruct mechanism that destroyed tooling and traces along the way, making the attack harder to investigate, Teng said.

The attacker used EIP-7702 , an Ethereum feature that lets standard wallets run smart contract code, to obtain onchain execution approval over a hot wallet, according to Teng. "That delegation did not pass through our normal approval controls," he said, which is why Binance paused withdrawals to rebuild and retest its infrastructure. Blockchain analytics firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis have attributed the theft to North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor.

Binance hopes to restore withdrawals before its Sunday deadline, Teng said, and is carrying out a full security review covering endpoints, cloud, key management and signing. It plans to publish a full proof of reserves report by Monday, with an initial view before then.

The attacker is still moving funds. Between 11:37 a.m. and 12:12 p.m. ET on Friday, a Tron wallet that Arkham attributes to the hacker sent about 5.19 million TRX, worth roughly $1.73 million, to 12 addresses, according to Arkham data .

All markets are now unfrozen across Aave V3 and V4.

They were frozen as a precaution after initial reports, which paused new deposits and borrows while withdrawals and repayments continued as normal.

Decentralized lending protocol Aave, where the attacker borrowed ETH against USDT while racing stablecoin freezes, according to TRM Labs , said on Friday that it had unfrozen all markets on its V3 and V4 deployments. It had frozen them as a precaution after the first reports of the hack, pausing new deposits and borrowing while withdrawals and repayments continued. Decrypt News Business Binance Sets Aside $6.34B to Cover Hack Losses, CEO Says 'Your Assets Are Safe'

Richard Teng said the attacker used a self-destruct mechanism and an EIP-7702 delegation that bypassed Binance's normal approval controls.

By Decrypt Agent Edited by Stephen Graves

Binance CEO Richard Teng. Image: Binance/Decrypt (CC BY 4.0)

Add on Google Add Decrypt as your preferred source to see more of our stories on Google.

Binance CEO Richard Teng said the exchange will cover all hacked losses, having reserved over $6.34 billion of company funds, $5 billion in the affected tokens.

Teng said the attacker used a self-destruct mechanism to wipe tooling and traces, and an EIP-7702 delegation that bypassed Binance's normal approval controls.

Binance aims to restore withdrawals by Sunday and publish a full proof of reserves by Monday, as the attacker keeps moving funds on Tron.

Binance will cover every dollar lost in this week's hack with its own money, CEO Richard Teng said in a video address on Friday, adding that customer funds were never touched.

"We are committed to covering all hacked losses through our company funds. Your assets are safe," Teng said, according to a transcript he tweeted.

An update on the security incident. pic.twitter.com/qn2804fO5z

— Richard Teng (@_RichardTeng) October 30, 2026

Binance has reserved more than $6.34 billion of company funds to cover the stolen assets, $5 billion of which is already held in the exact tokens taken, including USDC, USDT, BTC, ETH and BNB, he said. The exchange is buying the rest through market and over-the-counter channels.

Teng said the hack hit Binance's own hot wallet, not customer funds. "We never use any customer funds, so they are not impacted," he said, adding that most user assets are held in cold wallets and only moved into a hot wallet when a user withdraws. Binance's ability to absorb a loss of this size comes from keeping much of its operating earnings in crypto, he said.

Binance had earlier said it would cover all losses from its SAFU emergency fund and company funds.

Teng said the hack "was not carried out by one person." Binance initially traced it to a compromised laptop but has since found additional points of breach. The attacker also used a self-destruct mechanism that destroyed tooling and traces along the way, making the attack harder to investigate, Teng said.

The attacker used EIP-7702 , an Ethereum feature that lets standard wallets run smart contract code, to obtain onchain execution approval over a hot wallet, according to Teng. "That delegation did not pass through our normal approval controls," he said, which is why Binance paused withdrawals to rebuild and retest its infrastructure. Blockchain analytics firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis have attributed the theft to North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor.

Binance hopes to restore withdrawals before its Sunday deadline, Teng said, and is carrying out a full security review covering endpoints, cloud, key management and signing. It plans to publish a full proof of reserves report by Monday, with an initial view before then.

The attacker is still moving funds. Between 11:37 a.m. and 12:12 p.m. ET on Friday, a Tron wallet that Arkham attributes to the hacker sent about 5.19 million TRX, worth roughly $1.73 million, to 12 addresses, according to Arkham data .

All markets are now unfrozen across Aave V3 and V4.

They were frozen as a precaution after initial reports, which paused new deposits and borrows while withdrawals and repayments continued as normal.

Decentralized lending protocol Aave, where the attacker borrowed ETH against USDT while racing stablecoin freezes, according to TRM Labs , said on Friday that it had unfrozen all markets on its V3 and V4 deployments. It had frozen them as a precaution after the first reports of the hack, pausing new deposits and borrowing while withdrawals and repayments continued. "Aave was unaffected, and all positions remain overcollateralized," founder Stani Kulechov wrote .

Binance co-founder Changpeng "CZ" Zhao said that while the $6.3 billion theft is the largest in dollar terms, it is not the largest in Bitcoin terms, pointing to Mt. Gox's loss of 650,000 BTC, more than 5% of the supply. Unlike at Mt. Gox and FTX, where nearly all users were affected, Binance is covering the losses itself, he said. "It hurts, but we survive," Zhao wrote.

MEXC bất ngờ rút khỏi 4 quốc gia dù tham vọng cạnh tranh với các sàn giao dịch hàng đầu thế giới

Sàn crypto MEXC thông báo sẽ từng bước ngừng cung cấp dịch vụ cho người dùng tại Pháp , đánh dấu thị trường thứ tư mà sàn rút lui kể từ cuối tháng 9.

Theo thông báo ngày 28/10, MEXC sẽ bắt đầu áp dụng các hạn chế theo từng nhóm người dùng từ ngày 18/11 .

Các vị thế còn mở sẽ được tự động đóng vào ngày 22/1/2027 , trong khi hạn cuối để người dùng rút tài sản khỏi nền tảng là ngày 5/3/2027 .

Những tài sản còn lại sau thời hạn này dự kiến được chuyển sang một đơn vị lưu ký được quản lý, nhưng MEXC hiện chưa công bố danh tính bên tiếp nhận.

Trước Pháp, MEXC đã thông báo ngừng dịch vụ tại Hà Lan vào ngày 29/9 , sau đó tiếp tục rút khỏi Nga và Belarus ngày 20/10.

Động thái tại Pháp đáng chú ý hơn khi cơ quan quản lý tài chính AMF từng đưa MEXC vào danh sách cảnh báo từ tháng 6/2024 vì cung cấp dịch vụ mà không có giấy phép cần thiết.

Việc MiCA được triển khai rộng hơn tại châu Âu cũng khiến các sàn crypto phải đáp ứng yêu cầu cấp phép và tuân thủ nghiêm ngặt hơn.

MEXC cho biết người dùng Pháp sẽ chỉ có thể giảm hoặc đóng vị thế sau khi hạn chế có hiệu lực.

MEXC is withdrawing from France, its fourth country exit since September.

French users face automatic position closures on Jan. 22, 2027, and withdrawals end March 5.

— CryptoSlate (@CryptoSlate) October 30, 2026

MEXC vẫn muốn mở rộng sang nhiều loại tài sản

Dù rút khỏi một số thị trường, CEO Vugar Usi vẫn đang theo đuổi chiến lược mở rộng MEXC từ một sàn crypto tập trung nhiều vào memecoin sang nền tảng giao dịch đa tài sản.

MEXC hiện cho biết có khoảng 40 triệu người dùng , hơn 90% là khách hàng cá nhân.

Trong tháng 9, khối lượng giao dịch cổ phiếu Mỹ token hóa tăng 81% , còn nhóm cổ phiếu và ETF token hóa liên quan đến AI tăng 88% .

Sàn cũng đang cung cấp hơn 450 cặp futures cổ phiếu và chỉ số , cùng hơn 200 cổ phiếu Mỹ token hóa.

Tuy nhiên, việc liên tục rút khỏi các thị trường cho thấy tham vọng mở rộng toàn cầu của MEXC vẫn phải đối mặt với áp lực pháp lý ngày càng lớn , đặc biệt tại châu Âu.

CZ nhắn Elon Musk ngừng trêu chọc, tiết lộ lượng cổ phần SpaceX “của chúng ta” vượt 1 tỷ USD

Trong lúc Binance xử lý hậu quả vụ hack lớn ngày 30/10, đồng sáng lập Changpeng Zhao (CZ) bất ngờ nhắc tới lượng cổ phần SpaceX mà ông cho rằng Binance đang nắm giữ.

CZ cho biết khoản đầu tư này có liên quan đến 500 triệu USD Binance từng rót vào thương vụ Elon Musk mua Twitter , và hiện số cổ phần SpaceX tương ứng có giá trị hơn 1 tỷ USD .

Thông tin về quyền sở hữu, giá trị và mối liên hệ giữa khoản đầu tư Twitter với cổ phần SpaceX hiện chủ yếu dựa trên tuyên bố của CZ.

Trong một trao đổi với Elon Musk, CZ cũng đề nghị tỷ phú này ngừng “troll” trong thời điểm Binance đang xử lý khủng hoảng.

Yi He: Binance chưa cần bán cổ phần SpaceX

Đồng sáng lập Binance Yi He cho biết doanh thu trong năm của công ty đủ để bù đắp thiệt hại , nên Binance hiện chưa cần bán lượng cổ phần SpaceX nói trên.

CZ sau đó giải thích rằng ông chỉ muốn cho Musk thấy Binance vẫn có những tài sản giá trị lớn mà vị tỷ phú này có thể dễ dàng nhận biết.

Tuy nhiên, cần phân biệt rằng doanh thu hằng năm không đồng nghĩa với lượng tiền mặt có thể sử dụng ngay , còn giá trị cổ phần SpaceX cũng không phải tiền mặt cho tới khi được bán hoặc chuyển nhượng.

Elon, have a lot of respect for you, but bad time to troll. Please stop.

Our SPCX shares (from our $500m investment in your Twitter takeover) are worth more than a billion.

Would appreciate if you show a little support. Thanks!

— CZ 🔶 BNB (@cz_binance) October 30, 2026

Binance dành hơn 6 tỷ USD để xử lý thiệt hại

Trong cập nhật riêng, Binance cho biết đã dành hơn 6 tỷ USD nguồn lực của công ty để bù đắp tổn thất từ vụ hack .

Trong số này, khoảng 5 tỷ USD đã được nắm giữ dưới dạng chính các token bị ảnh hưởng , còn phần thiếu hụt đang được mua thêm qua thị trường và các giao dịch OTC.

Binance cho biết quá trình này có thể kéo dài do một số token có thanh khoản hạn chế.

Con số trên không bao gồm khoảng 3 tỷ USD tài sản bị đánh cắp đã được đóng băng , vì số tài sản này vẫn đang trong quá trình xác minh và thu hồi.

Do đó, việc Binance có thể bù đắp thiệt hại hiện dựa trên nhiều nguồn lực khác nhau, thay vì chỉ phụ thuộc vào lượng cổ phần SpaceX mà CZ đề cập.

posts.titleVi: Binance Hacked for $6.3B, Fed Holds Rates, Bitcoin Crashes to 6-Week Low: Weekly Crypto Recap
posts.summary: Although all crypto eyes were on the Federal Reserve FOMC meeting on Wednesday and a few other major macro events, none of those were the moment of the week. But first, let’s see how the week actually unfolded, starting from our previous market update from last Friday.
posts.summaryVi: Although all crypto eyes were on the Federal Reserve FOMC meeting on Wednesday and a few other major macro events, none of those were the moment of the week. But first, let’s see how the week actually unfolded, starting from our previous market update from last Friday.
posts.content:
Although all crypto eyes were on the Federal Reserve FOMC meeting on Wednesday and a few other major macro events, none of those were the moment of the week.

But first, let’s see how the week actually unfolded, starting from our previous market update from last Friday. At the time, BTC was fighting to stay above the key $80,000 support after getting rejected at $85,000, and investors braced for the FOMC meeting. Somewhat surprisingly, BTC dipped to a five-week low on Saturday at $79,100 before rebounding $2,000 on Sunday.

However, it couldn’t really maintain its position above $80,000 and dipped on a few more occasions by Tuesday. The bulls went on a mild run ahead of the FOMC meeting, pushing the asset to $81,700. It dipped before the meeting and jumped again to $81,800 after the central bank paused interest rate hikes as expected.

Another rejection followed, and BTC dropped to $80,500 on Thursday. The real impact came a day later, early on Friday morning, when reports emerged that the world’s largest crypto exchange had fallen victim to a major hack. Later on, the company confirmed the news, while on-chain data showed that the losses were somewhere around $6.3 billion, even though several entities, including Tether, froze roughly $3 billion.

This became by far the largest hack in the crypto industry. Naturally, bitcoin and almost all alts tanked, with the leading crypto asset dropping to a six-week low of $76,400 before rebounding by a grand. BNB dumped below $700, while SOL has slumped by over 7%. The liquidations skyrocketed to $1.5 billion, while the number of wiped-out traders jumped to over 235,000 on a daily scale.

Market Cap: $2.690T | 24H Vol: $152B | BTC Dominance: 57.8%

BTC: $77,380 (-5.1%) | ETH: $2,225 (-7.4%) | XRP: $1.25 (-4.5%)

Ripple Clears Final OCC Hurdle for National Trust Bank . Ripple had a massive week, and perhaps the OCC approval stands out at the top. Company CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced that the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has granted the final green light for the establishment of Ripple National Trust Bank.

Your Trezor Could Be Compromised: Company Issues Urgent Warning to Customers . One of the leading hardware wallet manufacturers warned customers who bought some of its devices from CryptoBilis on or after March 2026 to move their funds to a newly created wallet with a new seed as soon as possible.

Polymarket Trading Disrupted After Users Report $2.6M in Losses . Hours before the massive Binance hack, Polymarket admitted that bad actors drained over $2.6 million from user accounts. The platform went into cancel-only mode for a while, and Polymarket said an external provider was compromised, not its internal infrastructure.

Bitcoin Sees Biggest Exchange Outflow in Five Weeks Ahead of Fed Decision . In just a single day before the key FOMC meeting, on-chain data showed that bitcoin investors had withdrawn almost 15,000 units from exchanges. The company said this was the largest daily net outflow in five weeks.

Strive Makes Largest-Ever Bitcoin Purchase With 6,182 BTC Buy . The Matt Cole-led company announced its most significant bitcoin purchase to date, accumulating 6,182 units for over $510 million. Meanwhile, the largest corporate holder of the cryptocurrency stood on the sidelines.

HYPE Price Rises 15% Following NYSE Plan to Bring Hyperliquid Perps to the US . Although most altcoins are deep in the red this week, the graph above shows that HYPE has clearly defied that trend. Although all crypto eyes were on the Federal Reserve FOMC meeting on Wednesday and a few other major macro events, none of those were the moment of the week.

But first, let’s see how the week actually unfolded, starting from our previous market update from last Friday. At the time, BTC was fighting to stay above the key $80,000 support after getting rejected at $85,000, and investors braced for the FOMC meeting. Somewhat surprisingly, BTC dipped to a five-week low on Saturday at $79,100 before rebounding $2,000 on Sunday.

However, it couldn’t really maintain its position above $80,000 and dipped on a few more occasions by Tuesday. The bulls went on a mild run ahead of the FOMC meeting, pushing the asset to $81,700. It dipped before the meeting and jumped again to $81,800 after the central bank paused interest rate hikes as expected.

Another rejection followed, and BTC dropped to $80,500 on Thursday. The real impact came a day later, early on Friday morning, when reports emerged that the world’s largest crypto exchange had fallen victim to a major hack. Later on, the company confirmed the news, while on-chain data showed that the losses were somewhere around $6.3 billion, even though several entities, including Tether, froze roughly $3 billion.

This became by far the largest hack in the crypto industry. Naturally, bitcoin and almost all alts tanked, with the leading crypto asset dropping to a six-week low of $76,400 before rebounding by a grand. BNB dumped below $700, while SOL has slumped by over 7%. The liquidations skyrocketed to $1.5 billion, while the number of wiped-out traders jumped to over 235,000 on a daily scale.

BTC: $77,380 (-5.1%) | ETH: $2,225 (-7.4%) | XRP: $1.25 (-4.5%)

Ripple Clears Final OCC Hurdle for National Trust Bank . Ripple had a massive week, and perhaps the OCC approval stands out at the top. Company CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced that the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has granted the final green light for the establishment of Ripple National Trust Bank.

Your Trezor Could Be Compromised: Company Issues Urgent Warning to Customers . One of the leading hardware wallet manufacturers warned customers who bought some of its devices from CryptoBilis on or after March 2026 to move their funds to a newly created wallet with a new seed as soon as possible.

Polymarket Trading Disrupted After Users Report $2.6M in Losses . Hours before the massive Binance hack, Polymarket admitted that bad actors drained over $2.6 million from user accounts. The platform went into cancel-only mode for a while, and Polymarket said an external provider was compromised, not its internal infrastructure.

Bitcoin Sees Biggest Exchange Outflow in Five Weeks Ahead of Fed Decision . In just a single day before the key FOMC meeting, on-chain data showed that bitcoin investors had withdrawn almost 15,000 units from exchanges. The company said this was the largest daily net outflow in five weeks.

Strive Makes Largest-Ever Bitcoin Purchase With 6,182 BTC Buy . The Matt Cole-led company announced its most significant bitcoin purchase to date, accumulating 6,182 units for over $510 million. Meanwhile, the largest corporate holder of the cryptocurrency stood on the sidelines.

Decrypt News Business Elon Musk, CZ Trade Blows Over SpaceX Shares After $6.4B Binance Hack

After Musk appeared to mock Binance’s $6.3 billion hack, CZ reminded him that the exchange’s $500 million bet on his Twitter takeover is now worth over $1 billion in SpaceX shares.

By Jose Antonio Lanz Edited by Guillermo Jimenez

Elon Musk and Changpeng "CZ" Zhao. Image: Shutterstock/Decrypt

Add on Google Add Decrypt as your preferred source to see more of our stories on Google.

CZ asked Elon Musk to stop trolling Binance over its $6.3 billion hack, citing the exchange's SpaceX shares, which he values at more than $1 billion.

Binance co-CEO Yi He said the company's annual revenue is sufficient to cover the losses without selling its SpaceX holdings. CZ later clarified that he had never suggested selling the shares.

Binance has reserved more than $6.34 billion in company funds to cover the incident, while TRM Labs and Chainalysis have attributed the attack to North Korea-linked hacking group TraderTraitor.

Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao, better known as CZ, called out Elon Musk on Friday after the billionaire appeared to mock the exchange following a $6.4 billion hack—the largest in history—reminding him that Binance holds SpaceX shares worth more than $1 billion.

"Elon, have a lot of respect for you, but bad time to troll. Please stop," CZ wrote on X. "Our SPCX shares (from our $500m investment in your Twitter takeover) are worth more than a billion. Would appreciate if you show a little support. Thanks!"

The exchange followed Musk's response to a post estimating that, as a lot of the stolen funds have been frozen, Binance's losses could reach around $1 billion, despite holding approximately $144 billion in assets under custody.

Musk had replied to the discussion with a grimacing emoji, prompting another user to share an old post from former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried claiming his exchange had enough money to cover its losses. FTX famously collapsed weeks later.

Elon, have a lot of respect for you, but bad time to troll. Please stop.

Our SPCX shares (from our $500m investment in your Twitter takeover) are worth more than a billion.

Would appreciate if you show a little support. Thanks!

— CZ 🔶 BNB (@cz_binance) October 30, 2026

CZ had initially responded to the loss estimate by saying the damage might be somewhat higher but that Binance would still be able to cover it. Musk's emoji appeared to draw an uncomfortable parallel with the FTX episode, although he did not elaborate on what he meant.

Of course, CZ didn't imply anything else about what Binance may do with its SpaceX shares.

Binance co-CEO Yi He also joined the exchange, addressing CZ in a post that appeared to respond to the suggestion that the company might need to liquidate its SpaceX holdings.

"Reporting to the major shareholder: Our company's revenue for the year is sufficient to cover the losses, so we do not yet need to sell the SpaceX shares you are bullish on," she wrote, adding a shrugging emoji.

CZ subsequently clarified that he had never suggested selling the shares. He said he was simply showing Musk some of the funds Binance had available, hoping to reassure him about the exchange's financial position.

😂 did say anything about selling SPCX shares, was just saying/showing some funds that he might know, so that he can be less worried.

— CZ 🔶 BNB (@cz_binance) October 30, 2026

The argument comes as Binance deals with the largest cryptocurrency theft on record. At least $6.4 billion in crypto was taken from wallets associated with the exchange on Thursday, October 29, across multiple blockchains.

Just yesterday, initial reports showed that at least $5.57 billion had left Binance-linked wallets across Ethereum, Bitcoin, and Tron. The attackers moved funds through several transactions, including a transfer of more than $1.6 billion in USDT to a newly created Ethereum address.

The incident also exposed an important weakness in how cryptocurrency can be recovered after a theft. Tether and Circle, the companies behind the USDT and USDC stablecoins, froze approximately $1.8 billion in assets associated with the attackers in the initial response, then subsequently froze a total of $2.39 billion. Unlike those tokens, Ethereum cannot be frozen by a central issuer, making it harder to stop stolen funds once they are converted.

→ Buy Bitcoin with USDT Powered by Jupiter

Price data by CoinGecko CoinGecko More Bitcoin news and projections →

The attackers subsequently used decentralized exchanges such as Uniswap and lending protocol Aave to move funds into Ethereum. These platforms allow users to trade or borrow cryptocurrency without relying on a traditional intermediary to approve each transaction. Decrypt tracked wallets receiving tens of thousands of ETH through these operations, including 19,762 ETH borrowed against approximately $60 million in USDT.

The suspected attackers have also been linked to North Korea. In a Friday report , blockchain analytics firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed the attack to TraderTraitor, a North Korean hacking group previously blamed for the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in February 2025. Chainalysis estimated the Binance theft at approximately $6.4 billion.

Binance has since said it has reserved more than $6.34 billion in company funds to cover the incident, including $5 billion already held in the same tokens that were stolen. The exchange said it is acquiring the remaining assets through market and over-the-counter purchases, which can take longer when certain tokens have limited liquidity.

Decrypt News Business Elon Musk, CZ Trade Blows Over SpaceX Shares After $6.4B Binance Hack

After Musk appeared to mock Binance’s $6.3 billion hack, CZ reminded him that the exchange’s $500 million bet on his Twitter takeover is now worth over $1 billion in SpaceX shares.

By Jose Antonio Lanz Edited by Guillermo Jimenez

Elon Musk and Changpeng "CZ" Zhao. Image: Shutterstock/Decrypt

Add on Google Add Decrypt as your preferred source to see more of our stories on Google.

CZ asked Elon Musk to stop trolling Binance over its $6.3 billion hack, citing the exchange's SpaceX shares, which he values at more than $1 billion.

Binance co-CEO Yi He said the company's annual revenue is sufficient to cover the losses without selling its SpaceX holdings. CZ later clarified that he had never suggested selling the shares.

Binance has reserved more than $6.34 billion in company funds to cover the incident, while TRM Labs and Chainalysis have attributed the attack to North Korea-linked hacking group TraderTraitor.

Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao, better known as CZ, called out Elon Musk on Friday after the billionaire appeared to mock the exchange following a $6.4 billion hack—the largest in history—reminding him that Binance holds SpaceX shares worth more than $1 billion.

"Elon, have a lot of respect for you, but bad time to troll. Please stop," CZ wrote on X. "Our SPCX shares (from our $500m investment in your Twitter takeover) are worth more than a billion. Would appreciate if you show a little support. Thanks!"

The exchange followed Musk's response to a post estimating that, as a lot of the stolen funds have been frozen, Binance's losses could reach around $1 billion, despite holding approximately $144 billion in assets under custody.

Musk had replied to the discussion with a grimacing emoji, prompting another user to share an old post from former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried claiming his exchange had enough money to cover its losses. FTX famously collapsed weeks later.

Elon, have a lot of respect for you, but bad time to troll. Please stop.

Our SPCX shares (from our $500m investment in your Twitter takeover) are worth more than a billion.

Would appreciate if you show a little support. Thanks!

— CZ 🔶 BNB (@cz_binance) October 30, 2026

CZ had initially responded to the loss estimate by saying the damage might be somewhat higher but that Binance would still be able to cover it. Musk's emoji appeared to draw an uncomfortable parallel with the FTX episode, although he did not elaborate on what he meant.

Of course, CZ didn't imply anything else about what Binance may do with its SpaceX shares.

Binance co-CEO Yi He also joined the exchange, addressing CZ in a post that appeared to respond to the suggestion that the company might need to liquidate its SpaceX holdings.

"Reporting to the major shareholder: Our company's revenue for the year is sufficient to cover the losses, so we do not yet need to sell the SpaceX shares you are bullish on," she wrote, adding a shrugging emoji.

CZ subsequently clarified that he had never suggested selling the shares. He said he was simply showing Musk some of the funds Binance had available, hoping to reassure him about the exchange's financial position.

😂 did say anything about selling SPCX shares, was just saying/showing some funds that he might know, so that he can be less worried.

— CZ 🔶 BNB (@cz_binance) October 30, 2026

The argument comes as Binance deals with the largest cryptocurrency theft on record. At least $6.4 billion in crypto was taken from wallets associated with the exchange on Thursday, October 29, across multiple blockchains.

Just yesterday, initial reports showed that at least $5.57 billion had left Binance-linked wallets across Ethereum, Bitcoin, and Tron. The attackers moved funds through several transactions, including a transfer of more than $1.6 billion in USDT to a newly created Ethereum address.

The incident also exposed an important weakness in how cryptocurrency can be recovered after a theft. Tether and Circle, the companies behind the USDT and USDC stablecoins, froze approximately $1.8 billion in assets associated with the attackers in the initial response, then subsequently froze a total of $2.39 billion. Unlike those tokens, Ethereum cannot be frozen by a central issuer, making it harder to stop stolen funds once they are converted.

The attackers subsequently used decentralized exchanges such as Uniswap and lending protocol Aave to move funds into Ethereum. These platforms allow users to trade or borrow cryptocurrency without relying on a traditional intermediary to approve each transaction. Decrypt tracked wallets receiving tens of thousands of ETH through these operations, including 19,762 ETH borrowed against approximately $60 million in USDT.

The suspected attackers have also been linked to North Korea. In a Friday report , blockchain analytics firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed the attack to TraderTraitor, a North Korean hacking group previously blamed for the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in February 2025. Chainalysis estimated the Binance theft at approximately $6.4 billion.

Binance has since said it has reserved more than $6.34 billion in company funds to cover the incident, including $5 billion already held in the same tokens that were stolen. The exchange said it is acquiring the remaining assets through market and over-the-counter purchases, which can take longer when certain tokens have limited liquidity.

BOJ will more than double stock-fund sales from January

Annual ETF sales will rise from about ¥330 billion to ¥860 billion at book value from January 2027, while the BOJ can adjust or suspend sales.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 The new pace is ¥860 billion a year at book value, or about ¥2,460 billion at indicative market value. 02 The new pace targets about 0.1% of trading, while the BOJ retains discretion to adjust or suspend sales. 03 Bitcoin could be affected if equity volatility triggers margin calls and cuts to leveraged portfolios. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

The Bank of Japan will more than double its annual ETF sales following an Oct. 30 decision , increasing the stock-fund supply private investors will absorb from January 2027. Planned disposals rise from about ¥330 billion to ¥860 billion a year at book value.

Bitcoin ‘s exposure is indirect: stress in equities could spread through leveraged portfolios.

Related Reading Japan’s services inflation split complicates the BOJ outlook before Friday’s decision

The funds hold Japanese equities, rather than Bitcoin. The BOJ puts the new annual pace at about ¥2,460 billion at indicative market value. That conversion uses the market-to-book ratio of ETFs it sold during January through September 2026. Sales will be spread over the year, with the accelerated pace starting in January 2027.

The new pace targets about 0.1% of trading, calibrated using January-September 2026 Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market data. The earlier setting targeted about 0.05% of market trading at the time of the September 2025 decision. The two trading shares use different reference periods.

The BOJ's disposal framework allows it to temporarily adjust or suspend sales as financial-market conditions change. The bank says disposals since January 2026 have proceeded smoothly while avoiding a major market impact, alongside expanding stock-market trading.

The change concerns equity supply, while the overnight call-rate guideline stays around 1.25%, the target established in the September decision and effective Sept. 24. The ETF announcement therefore does not add a fresh policy-rate increase to yen borrowing costs.

Related Reading Bitcoin rallies after BOJ’s 1.25% hike, but the real yen-carry test starts next week

How faster ETF sales could affect Bitcoin

The Bank for International Settlements' September 2024 review offers a historical example of how stress can travel. It describes August 2024 turbulence in which yen appreciation, carry-trade unwinding and equity volatility coincided with broader deleveraging and margin calls, including in crypto. Carry trades use borrowing in lower-rate currencies to finance higher-yielding positions.

If equity volatility rises, leveraged investors facing portfolio limits or demands for more collateral could reduce holdings across assets, potentially reaching Bitcoin.

January's implementation will test how comfortably the market absorbs the faster ETF sales.

posts.content:
Cục An ninh mạng chỉ ra nguyên nhân nhiều tài khoản ngân hàng bị phong tỏa sau giao dịch P2P

Giao dịch thật nhưng tiền nhận về có thể là “tiền bẩn”

Thời gian gần đây, nhiều trường hợp tài khoản ngân hàng bị rà soát hoặc phong tỏa sau khi thực hiện giao dịch tài sản mã hóa qua P2P được ghi nhận.

Theo Cục An ninh mạng, rủi ro nằm ở chỗ USDT, BTC hoặc tài sản mã hóa được giao dịch hoàn toàn thật , nhưng số VND người bán nhận vào tài khoản có thể bắt nguồn từ tài khoản nghi liên quan rửa tiền hoặc tiền do lừa đảo chiếm đoạt.

Ví dụ, người dùng bán USDT và nhận 100 triệu đồng. Nếu khoản tiền đó liên quan một vụ lừa đảo, tài khoản nhận tiền có thể bị đưa vào quá trình xác minh dù người bán không biết nguồn gốc trước đó.

Tài khoản có thể bị phong tỏa để phục vụ xác minh

Điều 11 Nghị định 52/2024/NĐ-CP quy định tài khoản thanh toán có thể bị phong tỏa một phần hoặc toàn bộ khi có quyết định hoặc yêu cầu bằng văn bản của cơ quan có thẩm quyền .

Cục An ninh mạng lưu ý việc cá nhân sử dụng tài khoản ngân hàng hợp pháp để giao dịch tài sản mã hóa không mặc nhiên cấu thành hành vi rửa tiền , nhưng dòng tiền vẫn phải tuân thủ các quy định liên quan đến thanh toán và phòng, chống rửa tiền.

Rủi ro lớn nhất là người giao dịch P2P gần như không thể tự kiểm tra toàn bộ nguồn gốc dòng tiền ở các mắt xích trước đó.

Người giao dịch P2P nên lưu đầy đủ bằng chứng

Khi phát sinh xác minh, người dùng cần có khả năng chứng minh nguồn tiền, tài sản crypto và mối liên hệ trực tiếp giữa lệnh P2P với khoản VND nhận được .

Các dữ liệu nên lưu gồm sao kê ngân hàng, lịch sử lệnh P2P, thông tin đối tác, số lượng tài sản, tỷ giá, thời điểm thanh toán, nội dung trao đổi, địa chỉ ví và TXID.

Đặc biệt, người dùng được khuyến cáo không nhận tiền từ tài khoản ngân hàng không trùng với danh tính đối tác đã xác minh , không cho mượn tài khoản và không nhận chuyển tiền hộ.

Trong giao dịch P2P, bảo vệ bản thân không chỉ là giữ an toàn crypto mà còn phải chứng minh được đường đi của dòng tiền ngân hàng khi có sự cố.

Ví dụ, người dùng bán USDT và nhận 100 triệu đồng. Nếu khoản tiền đó liên quan một vụ lừa đảo, tài khoản nhận tiền có thể bị đưa vào quá trình xác minh dù người bán không biết nguồn gốc trước đó.

Tài khoản có thể bị phong tỏa để phục vụ xác minh

Điều 11 Nghị định 52/2024/NĐ-CP quy định tài khoản thanh toán có thể bị phong tỏa một phần hoặc toàn bộ khi có quyết định hoặc yêu cầu bằng văn bản của cơ quan có thẩm quyền .

Cục An ninh mạng lưu ý việc cá nhân sử dụng tài khoản ngân hàng hợp pháp để giao dịch tài sản mã hóa không mặc nhiên cấu thành hành vi rửa tiền , nhưng dòng tiền vẫn phải tuân thủ các quy định liên quan đến thanh toán và phòng, chống rửa tiền.

Rủi ro lớn nhất là người giao dịch P2P gần như không thể tự kiểm tra toàn bộ nguồn gốc dòng tiền ở các mắt xích trước đó.

Người giao dịch P2P nên lưu đầy đủ bằng chứng

Khi phát sinh xác minh, người dùng cần có khả năng chứng minh nguồn tiền, tài sản crypto và mối liên hệ trực tiếp giữa lệnh P2P với khoản VND nhận được .

Các dữ liệu nên lưu gồm sao kê ngân hàng, lịch sử lệnh P2P, thông tin đối tác, số lượng tài sản, tỷ giá, thời điểm thanh toán, nội dung trao đổi, địa chỉ ví và TXID.

Đặc biệt, người dùng được khuyến cáo không nhận tiền từ tài khoản ngân hàng không trùng với danh tính đối tác đã xác minh , không cho mượn tài khoản và không nhận chuyển tiền hộ.

Trong giao dịch P2P, bảo vệ bản thân không chỉ là giữ an toàn crypto mà còn phải chứng minh được đường đi của dòng tiền ngân hàng khi có sự cố.

posts.content:
Using a bank card to buy crypto takes a few minutes, but deciding where to make the purchase may require a bit more consideration. Platforms differ in fees and speed, and rules aren’t the same in every country.

This review examines Paybis from a card buyer’s perspective, covering payment methods, supported nations, available cryptocurrencies, and the fees worth checking beforehand. It also highlights who could benefit the most from the service and what to confirm before completing a transaction.

Paybis is a platform that simplifies buying cryptocurrencies. Users select the asset they want to purchase, choose their preferred payment option, and complete the transaction. The section below explains each step of the process in more detail.

Paybis accepts card payments, with PayPal and bank transfers also being available.

Payment choice affects both cost and speed, and card payments are usually instant once your account is verified. Bank transfers often cost less but can take several days. A platform that offers both lets you choose based on what matters most to you.

Multiple payment options also provide a backup plan. Since some card issuers occasionally decline crypto transactions, you can switch to an alternative settlement method. If you want to buy crypto on Paybis with a credit card , the Paybis homepage is the place to start.

Keep one risk in mind, though, since many issuers treat crypto purchases as cash advances. That can add a bank charge, and interest may start on day one. For many users, a debit card can be the most affordable payment option. Still, policies on cryptocurrency transactions vary by issuer, so it’s a good idea to confirm the rules before buying

PayPal suits buyers who prefer not to enter card details, and you can Paybis allows you to buy Bitcoin with PayPal . Check the limits and fees for that method before you confirm.

Paybis serves customers in 180+ countries. That is a wide reach for a card buyer who travels or lives abroad.

Wide coverage is a plus, but availability can still vary by region. Payment methods, spending limits, and local regulations are not always the same in the US, the EU, and other parts of the world. It’s therefore worth checking that the platform and its key features are available in your country before signing up.

Paybis lists 90+ cryptocurrencies. A long list gives you room to start with one asset and add others later.

The fact that an asset is listed on a platform shouldn’t be viewed as an endorsement. Every cryptocurrency carries risk, and smaller tokens tend to be more volatile than established ones, often posting larger gains but also steeper declines. That said, always do your own research before buying and avoid investing more than you can comfortably afford to lose.

This review does not quote fee percentages as they change and can vary by payment method and country. Read the quote on the final confirmation screen instead.

Compare the total you pay with the amount of crypto you receive. That figure is more useful than any headline rate. For Paybis, check the current fee page before you order.

Many crypto platforms require identity verification before allowing a first purchase. The exact requirements may depend on your location, so it’s a good idea to review Paybis’ verification process before creating an account. As a result, your first purchase may take longer than future transactions.

It is also important to protect your account. To do that, turn on two-factor authentication and double-check wallet addresses before you send anything.

A short checklist helps you judge any platform, including Paybis. Answer these before you pay.

Write down your answers. If one of them is unclear, pause and read the platform’s current terms. Support quality also matters. Ask a simple question before you commit a larger sum, and see how quickly you get a clear reply.

Paybis could suit buyers who want flexibility. Users can choose from several payment methods, including PayPal and bank transfers, rather than relying solely on card payments. The platform’s broad international availability may help people outside major crypto hubs, while its long list of supported cryptocurrencies offers plenty of options for portfolio diversification.

Before creating an account, take a look at the fee page if you want to understand the exact costs involved. For larger purchases, it’s also worth comparing the total cost across multiple platforms to ensure you’re getting the best deal.

Paybis offers several payment options, wide country coverage, and a long list of assets. Whether it fits you depends on the fees and limits in your country. Check both before you order.

A small test purchase is a sensible first step. It allows you to see the quote, the verification process, and the time to completion. Increase your amount only if the experience suits you.

If you plan to hold Bitcoin, learn how the Bitcoin halving affects new supply.

Written by William Suberg staff writer Edited by Charles Bennett staff editor Written by William Suberg staff writer Edited by Charles Bennett staff editor

Bitcoin risks worst October in 12 years as tech sell-off spreads to gold

Markets Published Oct 30, 2026 Bitcoin circled $77,000 as crypto markets navigated US stock-market downside, while the gold price fell to its lowest in a year.

Bitcoin (BTC) stayed under pressure below $80,000 at Friday’s Wall Street open as AI fears returned to intensify a broader risk-asset rout.

Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD down 1.1% on the day after dropping to its lowest levels since Sept. 18.

BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView

US stock markets opened sharply lower as traders reacted to weak forward guidance from tech giants. Intel, which on Thursday warned of weaker Q4 sales than markets had anticipated, saw its stock price drop by nearly 30% on Friday’s open.

The sell-off weighed on both tech giants and chipmakers, with analysis warning of fresh challenges to AI-sector confidence.

“With renewed fears over AI Monetization, the Equity rotation is likely to continue today but the broader indices will reflect Tech’s downside,” JPMorgan wrote in a note, quoted by CNBC.

The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index was 2.5% lower at the time of writing at around 25,500, a level last seen on Aug. 3.

Nasdaq Composite Index one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView

Beyond stocks, contagion spread to precious metals, with gold trading as low as $3,891 per ounce, its weakest in a year.

XAU/USD one-week chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView

Crypto markets continued to deal with the aftermath of a multi-billion dollar hack of Binance, the largest crypto exchange.

Related: Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?

The platform said that it would cover the losses with its own capital after the theft of $6.3 billion in coins and tokens. A spokesperson told Cointelegraph that Binance had $5 billion in matching tokens currently available.

Commenting on the outlook for crypto, trading company QCP Capital warned that macro conditions, tech-sector fears and the Binance hack had “created a period of heightened market repricing.”

“Technology sector earnings guidance regarding future capital expenditure will remain a critical variable for understanding the trajectory of artificial intelligence infrastructure investment and expected profitability,” it summarized in analysis on Friday.

At $77,000, BTC/USD was set to close the month 7.7% lower — its worst October performance since 2014, per data from CoinGlass .

BTC/USD monthly returns. Source: CoinGlass

posts.content:
Ông Nguyễn Duy Hưng đặt câu hỏi đáng chú ý: Nếu sàn crypto Việt bị hack, lấy gì để đền?

Vụ Binance 6,3 tỷ USD đặt lại bài toán bảo vệ nhà đầu tư

Sự cố bảo mật mới nhất của Binance một lần nữa cho thấy quy mô thiệt hại có thể rất lớn khi hạ tầng của một sàn crypto bị xâm nhập.

Ngày 30/10, Binance cho biết điều tra sơ bộ cho thấy máy tính của một kỹ sư DevOps có thể đã bị xâm nhập, tạo điều kiện để kẻ tấn công truy cập container dịch vụ và gửi các lệnh rút tiền trái phép.

Tổng giá trị ảnh hưởng được Binance ước tính khoảng 6,3 tỷ USD , trong đó khoảng 3 tỷ USD tài sản đã được đóng băng on-chain. Sàn cho biết sẽ sử dụng quỹ SAFU và nguồn lực công ty để bù đắp thiệt hại cho người dùng.

Chủ tịch SSI từng đặt câu hỏi: Sàn Việt Nam lấy gì để đền?

Bài toán này từng được ông Nguyễn Duy Hưng, Chủ tịch SSI Digital, đề cập từ tháng 5/2025 sau vụ Bybit bị tấn công khoảng 1,4 tỷ USD .

“Bybit có cái để đền ngay, vậy một sàn của Việt Nam lấy gì để đền cho nhà đầu tư?”

Theo ông Hưng, bên cạnh bảo mật và chống hacker, các tổ chức vận hành thị trường cần có năng lực tài chính đủ lớn để xử lý sự cố.

Thời điểm đó, ông đưa ra con số 10.000 tỷ đồng , cho rằng đây là mức “tạm đủ” để có khả năng bù đắp rủi ro tại thị trường Việt Nam.

Việt Nam hiện yêu cầu vốn tối thiểu 10.000 tỷ đồng

Đáng chú ý, Nghị quyết 05/2025/NQ-CP về thí điểm thị trường tài sản mã hóa sau đó quy định tổ chức muốn được cấp phép vận hành thị trường phải có vốn điều lệ đã góp tối thiểu 10.000 tỷ đồng bằng VND .

Quy định này không đồng nghĩa 10.000 tỷ đồng có thể bù đắp mọi sự cố, bởi thiệt hại từ các cuộc tấn công lớn có thể vượt xa mức vốn của doanh nghiệp.

Tuy nhiên, vụ Binance cho thấy yêu cầu về năng lực tài chính, an toàn hệ thống và phương án xử lý tổn thất là yếu tố đặc biệt quan trọng khi Việt Nam xây dựng thị trường giao dịch tài sản mã hóa được cấp phép.

posts.title: Ethereum Price Analysis: Is $2K Next as Coinbase Premium Hits Yearly Low?
posts.titleVi: Ethereum Price Analysis: Is $2K Next as Coinbase Premium Hits Yearly Low?
posts.summary: Ethereum has slipped toward $2.2K after another wave of selling extended the decline from the $2.8K highs. With ETH now trading inside a key demand zone that also aligns with the lower boundary of its short-term descending channel, the current area could decide whether the correc…
posts.summaryVi: Ethereum has slipped toward $2.2K after another wave of selling extended the decline from the $2.8K highs. With ETH now trading inside a key demand zone that also aligns with the lower boundary of its short-term descending channel, the current area could decide whether the correc…
posts.content:
Ethereum has slipped toward $2.2K after another wave of selling extended the decline from the $2.8K highs. With ETH now trading inside a key demand zone that also aligns with the lower boundary of its short-term descending channel, the current area could decide whether the correction stabilizes or deepens toward lower support. Meanwhile, the Coinbase Premium Index has dropped to its lowest reading in over a year, pointing to notably weak demand from US investors.

Ethereum’s daily chart shows that the ascending channel that carried the price higher from the June lows near $1.5K has been broken. After rejection from the $2.8K supply zone in September, ETH fell below the channel’s lower boundary and then retested it around $2.5K, where sellers rejected the price again. This failed retest suggests the former support has turned into resistance.

The decline has now brought the asset into the $2.2K–$2.3K demand zone, which is located below the consolidation after August’s sharp rally. Today’s candle briefly wicked toward $2.15K before recovering, indicating that buyers are responding. However, the rebound remains modest, and the zone has yet to produce a convincing reaction.

If this support holds, ETH could attempt a recovery toward $2.5K. On the contrary, a valid daily close below $2.2K would expose the $1.9K order block, which is the base of the August rally and the next major demand area visible on the chart.

The 4-hour chart shows Ethereum trading within a descending channel since early October, characterized by consistent lower highs and lower lows. The upper boundary has acted as dynamic resistance, most notably on October 21, when the price was rejected decisively from the $2.5K zone. After several days of ranging between approximately $2.3K and $2.4K, ETH broke lower aggressively.

The sell-off briefly pushed the price to the channel’s lower boundary near $2.15K, where buyers stepped in. ETH is now consolidating around $2.24K, inside the horizontal demand zone. This confluence of channel support and horizontal demand makes the current region particularly important for the short-term outlook.

A successful defense could produce a relief bounce toward the $2.4K range highs and the channel’s upper boundary near $2.42K, and a potential breakout above it would weaken the bearish structure. On the other hand, a confirmed move beneath the lower trendline would signal that sellers have regained control, leaving the $1.9K region as the next likely target.

The Coinbase Premium Index on CryptoQuant measures the price gap between ETH on Coinbase, a venue widely used by US investors, and Binance. Positive readings indicate stronger buying from US participants, while negative values suggest weaker demand or heavier selling on Coinbase relative to the broader market.

Throughout mid-2025, the index remained largely positive as ETH rallied toward $4.7K. Since November 2025, readings have mostly stayed negative, coinciding with the asset’s prolonged downtrend. The metric briefly turned positive in September 2026 around the $2.5K-$2.6K consolidation, but it has since collapsed to approximately -0.21, which is arguably the deepest reading in the visible period, alongside the latest drop toward $2.2K.

This suggests US demand has weakened sharply. Notably, a similarly extreme reading in February 2026 occurred close to a local low, so the current figure could also reflect capitulation rather than sustained selling. Either way, the index would need to recover alongside price for ETH to defend the $2.2K support and challenge the $2.5K resistance. Otherwise, the excess supply and weak technicals could bring ETH back below $2K soon.

By Oluwapelumi Adejumo Senior Reporter • CryptoSlate

01 MEXC has withdrawn from four countries since September as its new CEO seeks to transform the 40 million-user exchange into a multi-asset trading platform. 02 The retreat contrasts with an 81% surge in tokenized US stock trading and exploratory partnership discussions with Kraken's parent, Payward. 03 MEXC's expansion ambitions face a major test as regulatory restrictions narrow its geographic reach and force customers to move assets elsewhere. Crypto exchange MEXC is withdrawing from France, marking its fourth country-level retreat since September as its new chief executive pursues an ambitious global expansion.

The exchange said in an Oct. 28 notice that it would gradually discontinue services to French customers, automatically close outstanding trading positions by Jan. 22, 2027, and terminate withdrawals on March 5.

The decision extends a series of market exits under CEO Vugar Usi, who is seeking to transform the platform from a cryptocurrency exchange associated with memecoin speculation into a broader trading business offering tokenized equities, commodities and prediction markets.

MEXC began the latest withdrawals with the Netherlands on Sept. 29 , citing regulatory developments in the European Economic Area. It subsequently announced the discontinuation of services to customers in Russia and Belarus on Oct. 20 as part of its global compliance efforts.

The retreat from France is particularly significant because the country's financial regulator, Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF), blacklisted MEXC in June 2024 for offering financial services without the required authorization.

The latest withdrawal also comes as Europe's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) imposes authorization requirements on cryptocurrency service providers, increasing the pressure on exchanges operating without the necessary regulatory approvals.

MEXC said French customers would face restrictions in four batches beginning Nov. 18, preventing them from opening new positions or making additional deposits once their assigned restrictions take effect.

Outstanding positions will be automatically settled on Jan. 22 based on prevailing market conditions and available liquidity, potentially exposing customers to losses or additional fees.

Any assets remaining after the March withdrawal deadline will be transferred to a regulated custodian, which the exchange has yet to identify.

Meanwhile, MEXC has begun offering affected French customers referrals to EU-regulated trading platforms, although users must independently open accounts and transfer their holdings before the withdrawal deadline.

MEXC's global ambitions face growing regulatory constraints

The market withdrawals contrast with Usi's strategy to expand MEXC's product offerings and establish the exchange as a retail-focused competitor across cryptocurrency and traditional financial markets.

Usi, who became CEO in April, has outlined plans to broaden the company's historically speculation-driven business into a platform that lets users trade multiple asset classes through a single interface.

The strategy builds on MEXC's approximately 40 million users, more than 90% of whom are retail customers, giving the exchange an established audience for new financial products.

Usi has also placed regulatory compliance and customer protection at the center of his leadership approach, emphasizing operational execution and the need to build trust among retail users.

The diversification strategy is already generating activity.

According to MEXC's September trading report , tokenized US stock spot trading volume increased 81% month over month, while trading in AI-related tokenized equities and ETFs rose 88%.

The exchange said it now offers more than 450 stock and index futures trading pairs and over 200 tokenized US equities, alongside its RealStocks service, which provides access to more than 7,000 US stocks and exchange-traded funds.

These offerings could help MEXC capture demand from retail traders seeking exposure beyond digital assets, although recent withdrawals have narrowed the number of jurisdictions where customers can access its services.

Related Reading Coinbase sets 3-day MiCA deadline for USDT, PayPal and Trump-linked stablecoins

The company is also exploring external partnerships to strengthen its international business.

Earlier this month, MEXC disclosed discussions with Payward, the parent company of US cryptocurrency exchange Kraken, about a potential collaboration involving market access, trading infrastructure, and liquidity.

The companies identified complementary strengths, with MEXC emphasizing retail trading and access to crypto and traditional financial products, while Payward brings established financial infrastructure and a significant US market presence.

The discussions remain exploratory, and neither company has announced a definitive agreement or operational integration.

posts.title: Crypto Price Analysis Oct-30: ETH, XRP, ADA, BNB, and HYPE
posts.titleVi: Crypto Price Analysis Oct-30: ETH, XRP, ADA, BNB, and HYPE
posts.summary: Today, we take a closer look at Ethereum, Ripple, Cardano, Binance Coin, and Hyperliquid. Markets turned turbulent today after Binance experienced the largest hack ever recorded at over $6 billion. Ethereum was quick to react, falling by 7% on the weekly timeframe.
posts.summaryVi: Today, we take a closer look at Ethereum, Ripple, Cardano, Binance Coin, and Hyperliquid. Markets turned turbulent today after Binance experienced the largest hack ever recorded at over $6 billion. Ethereum was quick to react, falling by 7% on the weekly timeframe.
posts.content:
Today, we take a closer look at Ethereum, Ripple, Cardano, Binance Coin, and Hyperliquid.

Markets turned turbulent today after Binance experienced the largest hack ever recorded at over $6 billion. Ethereum was quick to react, falling by 7% on the weekly timeframe.

The current resistance is found at $2,400, and this level used to act as support in the past, but buyers were unable to hold off the sell pressure. Considering the current market sentiment, a test of the $2,000 support appears likely in the coming days.

Looking ahead, sentiment is bearish, and the price is making lower lows. This may continue until ETH lands on the key support. Once there, bulls could send the leading altcoin into a relief rally.

XRP closes the week 6% lower as sellers continue their pressure after turning $1.3 into a resistance level. With that key line lost, buyers have likely moved closer to $1.17, which is the next support.

With the bearish momentum building up, the XRP price remains in a downtrend, which is expected to continue. The best chance to reverse this adverse move is at $1.17, which may give buyers an opening to return.

Looking ahead, the cross-border token is about to erase most of its gains from August as the correction unfolds. XRP needs to prevent a lower low under $1 if it wants buyers to regain confidence later.

ADA closes another week in red with a 10% loss after sellers returned in force, mostly due to the recent market turbulence related to the Binance hack. Unfortunately for bulls, the price also broke the $0.20 support, which is now acting as resistance.

With no relief in sight, Cardano’s token will have to fall lower until buyers become interested again. The closest support that could reverse this price action is found around $0.17. However, buyers could also wait for $0.15, which held well back in June.

Looking ahead, ADA is in a deep correction that is somewhat normal after its rally from $0.15 to $0.28. However, if the price continues to fall back to $0.15, then confidence in a sustained recovery will be low.

Even if Binance experienced the largest crypto hack on record, BNB only fell by 7% on the weekly chart. This shows that Binance is extremely resilient and its exchange is highly profitable if it is able to absorb billions in losses.

Nevertheless, the BNB price did land on the $690 support, which is currently being tested. If, for any reason, this level is lost again, then this cryptocurrency will likely fall towards $580 next.

Looking ahead, holders of Binance Coin are likely to be on edge in the next few weeks and months as this recent Binance hack finds its resolution. Any loss of trust in Binance will quickly translate into BNB’s price action.

In a surprising move, Hyperliquid will become the infrastructure layer for ICE (the owner of the New York Stock Exchange) as it deploys futures markets for US traders across crypto, equities, commodities, foreign exchange, and other real-world assets.

This announcement turned the chart extremely bullish just as the price was about to drop from its ascending channel. The timing of this could not have been better, and HYPE rallied back to $97. However, sellers returned again to stop it from hitting $100.

Looking ahead, Hyperliquid’s market position and fundamentals are perhaps the best in crypto right now, and the price action throughout 2026 showed it. But for the rally to continue, bulls need to turn $100 into support.

CZ asks Musk to stop trolling, saying ‘our’ SpaceX shares top $1 billion

CZ linked a claimed billion-dollar-plus holding to Binance’s Twitter investment; Yi He said annual revenue was sufficient to cover losses.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 CZ linked the claimed holding to a $500 million investment in Musk’s Twitter takeover. 02 Yi He said annual revenue was sufficient to cover losses, leaving a SpaceX share sale unnecessary for now. 03 Binance said it reserved over $6 billion in company funds, excluding frozen assets still awaiting recovery. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao asked Elon Musk to stop trolling during the exchange’s hack crisis on Oct. 30, citing SpaceX shares he valued at more than $1 billion as he appealed for support. Fellow co-founder Yi He subsequently said Binance did not yet need to sell those shares to cover the losses.

“Elon, have a lot of respect for you, but bad time to troll. Please stop,” Zhao wrote as @cz_binance , before asking Musk to show support.

Musk, posting as @elonmusk, had used a grimacing-face emoji earlier in the exchange.

Zhao called the holding “our SPCX shares,” linked it to a $500 million investment in Musk’s Twitter takeover and said it was worth more than a billion dollars. That ownership, valuation and investment connection remain Zhao’s account.

Related Reading Binance uncovers more breach points in $6 billion hack

Yi He, posting as @heyibinance , said the company’s revenue for the year was sufficient to cover the losses, so it did “not yet need to sell” the SpaceX shares.

Zhao then explained his reference to the shares in a reply to her: he was showing Musk funds he might recognize so he could be less worried.

Binance later gave a separate funding update, saying it had reserved more than $6 billion of company funds to cover the incident.

In another post describing his “rough math,” Zhao weighed the hack losses against frozen assets, the Secure Asset Fund for Users, or SAFU, and the estimated SPCX holding. He described the remaining gap as painful but manageable.

Revenue over a year is different from funds available at a particular moment. An estimated equity value is different from cash, while frozen stolen assets still have to be recovered.

Related Reading SpaceX perpetual futures traded about $6 billion after earnings

SpaceX shares and Binance’s funding commitment

In its later Oct. 30 funding statement, @binance said $5 billion of the company funds it had reserved was already held in the exact token assets affected. It said it was purchasing the remainder through market and over-the-counter channels.

Binance said that process could take longer because some tokens had low liquidity and over-the-counter settlement took time. The purchases were intended to match the affected token assets and address shortfalls, according to the company.

Binance expressly separated those figures from frozen or protected assets. It reported $3 billion frozen, while saying those assets remained subject to ongoing recovery and verification. That distinction keeps the company’s funding commitment separate from the outcome of efforts to retrieve stolen assets.

[2] Reported statement @cz_binance explained in a reply to @heyibinance that he was showing Musk funds he might recognize so he could be less worried; his post did not announce a share sale. [3] Reported statement @binance said at 10:55 on October 30 that it had reserved over $6.34 billion of company funds and that $5 billion was already held in the affected token assets, with remaining purchases underway. [4] Reported statement @binance said those reserved-fund figures excluded frozen or protected assets, reported $3 billion frozen, and said those assets remained subject to recovery and verification. [4] Method

Zhao then explained his reference to the shares in a reply to her: he was showing Musk funds he might recognize so he could be less worried.

Binance later gave a separate funding update, saying it had reserved more than $6 billion of company funds to cover the incident.

In another post describing his “rough math,” Zhao weighed the hack losses against frozen assets, the Secure Asset Fund for Users, or SAFU, and the estimated SPCX holding. He described the remaining gap as painful but manageable.

Revenue over a year is different from funds available at a particular moment. An estimated equity value is different from cash, while frozen stolen assets still have to be recovered.

Related Reading SpaceX perpetual futures traded about $6 billion after earnings

SpaceX shares and Binance’s funding commitment

In its later Oct. 30 funding statement, @binance said $5 billion of the company funds it had reserved was already held in the exact token assets affected. It said it was purchasing the remainder through market and over-the-counter channels.

Binance said that process could take longer because some tokens had low liquidity and over-the-counter settlement took time. The purchases were intended to match the affected token assets and address shortfalls, according to the company.

Binance expressly separated those figures from frozen or protected assets. It reported $3 billion frozen, while saying those assets remained subject to ongoing recovery and verification. That distinction keeps the company’s funding commitment separate from the outcome of efforts to retrieve stolen assets.
